_comment: Curated source library + provenance model (spec §3.1). Every citation MUST carry a source_type. This is the grounding allowlist for v1 (curated-core). Add publishers as needed; keep the type honest.

source_types.government: Official statistics / departmental data. Highest trust for measurable baselines.
source_types.advocacy: Campaigning bodies with a declared agenda. Usable, but ALWAYS labelled; never the sole basis for a verdict.
source_types.commercial: Firms with a financial interest in the narrative. Treat with the most caution.
source_types.media: Reporting. Trace to the underlying source before relying on it.

weighting_rules: Prefer government / institutional / academic for measurable (yellow-tier) baselines.
advocacy and commercial sources may be cited but are ALWAYS labelled, and may NOT be the sole basis for a verdict.
If a verdict leans materially on advocacy/commercial evidence on EITHER side, set advocacy_flag and say so in the rationale.
Provenance imbalance on either side is surfaced in the UI, never hidden.
